sourceText:
Yam Balls
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




2 yam (or potato) slices
Vegetable oil
Tomato sauce, well seasoned
2 eggs
Bread crumbs
Sardines, tuna or gr

Preparation

1 Boil the yams (or potatoes) and mash until there are no more lumps. Add the tomato sauce. Add the fish or whatever meat desired. Add one egg to the mixture to bind. 2 Divide into the number of balls desired (recipe 8 to 10 balls). Dip the balls into one beaten egg and coat with bread crumbs. Fry in deep vegetable oil until golden brown.
